594    /**
595     * Return a postcode based on state
596     *
597     * @example '55100'
598     *
599     * @see https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Postal_codes_in_Malaysia#States
600     *
601     * @param string|null $state 'state' or null
602     *
603     * @return string
604     */
605    public static function postcode($state = null)
606    {
607        $format = [
608            'perlis' => [ // (01000 - 02800)
609                '0' . self::numberBetween(1000, 2800),
610            ],
611            'kedah' => [ // (05000 - 09810)
612                '0' . self::numberBetween(5000, 9810),
613            ],
614            'penang' => [ // (10000 - 14400)
615                self::numberBetween(10000, 14400),
616            ],
617            'kelantan' => [ // (15000 - 18500)
618                self::numberBetween(15000, 18500),
619            ],
620            'terengganu' => [ // (20000 - 24300)
621                self::numberBetween(20000, 24300),
622            ],
623            'pahang' => [ // (25000 - 28800 | 39000 - 39200 | 49000, 69000)
624                self::numberBetween(25000, 28800),
625                self::numberBetween(39000, 39200),
626                self::numberBetween(49000, 69000),
627            ],
628            'perak' => [ // (30000 - 36810)
629                self::numberBetween(30000, 36810),
630            ],
631            'selangor' => [ // (40000 - 48300 | 63000 - 68100)
632                self::numberBetween(40000, 48300),
633                self::numberBetween(63000, 68100),
634            ],
635            'kl' => [ // (50000 - 60000)
636                self::numberBetween(50000, 60000),
637            ],
638            'putrajaya' => [ // (62000 - 62988)
639                self::numberBetween(62000, 62988),
640            ],
641            'nsembilan' => [ // (70000 - 73509)
642                self::numberBetween(70000, 73509),
643            ],
644            'melaka' => [ // (75000 - 78309)
645                self::numberBetween(75000, 78309),
646            ],
647            'johor' => [ // (79000 - 86900)
648                self::numberBetween(79000, 86900),
649            ],
650            'labuan' => [ // (87000 - 87033)
651                self::numberBetween(87000, 87033),
652            ],
653            'sabah' => [ // (88000 - 91309)
654                self::numberBetween(88000, 91309),
655            ],
656            'sarawak' => [ // (93000 - 98859)
657                self::numberBetween(93000, 98859),
658            ],
659        ];
660
661        $postcode = null === $state ? static::randomElement($format) : $format[$state];
662
663        return (string) static::randomElement($postcode);
664    }
665
666    /**
667     * Return the complete town address with matching postcode and state
668     *
669     * @example 55100 Bukit Bintang, Kuala Lumpur
670     *
671     * @return string
672     */
673    public function townState()
674    {
675        $state = static::randomElement(array_keys(static::$states));
676        $postcode = static::postcode($state);
677        $town = static::randomElement(static::$towns[$state]);
678        $state = static::randomElement(static::$states[$state]);
679
680        return $postcode . ' ' . $town . ', ' . $state;
681    }
